description: Shows IP addresses shared by phones across two or more servers at the same time. Pick the servers to watch. 'Live now' is real-time; the rest is recorded every 5 minutes so you can look back over time.

options.content:
**What this shows:** IP addresses that are being used by phones on **two or more different servers at the same time** — one of which is a server you picked in the **Servers** box (top-left). When two servers share the same IP address, their phones look like they're coming from the same place.

**Live now** = the situation this minute (updates every minute). **Recorded history** = the same check stored every 5 minutes, so you can look back over time using the time range (top-right).

panels.description: How many IP addresses are, right now, used at the same time by phones on two or more different servers (at least one of them selected). 0 = no overlap right now. Lower is better.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM (
  SELECT last_ip FROM (
    SELECT p.last_ip,
      CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'Unknown' END AS server_label
    FROM proxies p
    WHERE p.last_ip IS NOT NULL AND p.last_ip <> ''
      AND ('${proxy_scope}' = 'all' OR p.proxy_status = '${proxy_scope}')
  ) d
  GROUP BY last_ip
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT server_label) >= 2
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN server_label IN (${server:sqlstring}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
) t

targets.rawSql:
WITH dev AS (
  SELECT p.last_ip, p.name, p.device_id,
    CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'Unknown' END AS server_label,
    CONCAT_WS(', ', NULLIF(TRIM(p.city),''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.state),''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.country),'')) AS location
  FROM proxies p
  WHERE p.last_ip IS NOT NULL AND p.last_ip <> ''
    AND ('${proxy_scope}' = 'all' OR p.proxy_status = '${proxy_scope}')
),
ip_qual AS (
  SELECT last_ip FROM dev GROUP BY last_ip
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT server_label) >= 2
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN server_label IN (${server:sqlstring}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM dev d JOIN ip_qual q ON q.last_ip = d.last_ip

panels.description: Every IP currently shared across servers: the servers involved, how many phones are on it, the phone names, their device IDs, and location. Straight from live data, no delay.

targets.rawSql:
WITH dev AS (
  SELECT p.last_ip, p.name, p.device_id,
    CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'Unknown' END AS server_label,
    CONCAT_WS(', ', NULLIF(TRIM(p.city),''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.state),''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.country),'')) AS location
  FROM proxies p
  WHERE p.last_ip IS NOT NULL AND p.last_ip <> ''
    AND ('${proxy_scope}' = 'all' OR p.proxy_status = '${proxy_scope}')
),
ip_qual AS (
  SELECT last_ip FROM dev GROUP BY last_ip
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT server_label) >= 2
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN server_label IN (${server:sqlstring}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
)
SELECT d.last_ip AS `Shared IP`,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d.server_label ORDER BY d.server_label SEPARATOR ', ') AS `Servers sharing it`,
  COUNT(*) AS `Phones on IP`,
  GROUP_CONCAT(d.name ORDER BY d.name SEPARATOR ' | ') AS `Phones`,
  GROUP_CONCAT(d.device_id ORDER BY d.name SEPARATOR ' | ') AS `Device IDs`,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d.location ORDER BY d.location SEPARATOR ' | ') AS `Location`
FROM dev d JOIN ip_qual q ON q.last_ip = d.last_ip
GROUP BY d.last_ip
ORDER BY `Phones on IP` DESC, d.last_ip

Most recent check in the selected time range

panels.description: The 5-minute window (UTC) of the most recent recorded check WITHIN the time range you picked (top-right). Change the time range and this changes too. For the always-current picture use the 'Live now' panels at the top.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(captured_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS `Latest check (UTC)`,
  TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, MAX(captured_at), UTC_TIMESTAMP()) AS `Minutes ago`
FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers
WHERE $__timeFilter(captured_at)

panels.title: Latest check in range

panels.description: Number of IPs shared across servers in the most recent recorded check. Should match 'Live now' when the data is fresh.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(captured_at) AS captured_at
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers
  WHERE proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}' AND $__timeFilter(captured_at)
), xips AS (
  SELECT s.last_ip
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
  JOIN latest l ON l.captured_at = s.captured_at
  WHERE s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}' AND s.last_ip <> '__snapshot_empty__'
  GROUP BY s.last_ip
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.server_label) >= 2
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN s.server_label IN (${server:sqlstring}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM xips

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(captured_at) AS captured_at
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers
  WHERE proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}' AND $__timeFilter(captured_at)
), xips AS (
  SELECT s.last_ip
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
  JOIN latest l ON l.captured_at = s.captured_at
  WHERE s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}' AND s.last_ip <> '__snapshot_empty__'
  GROUP BY s.last_ip
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.server_label) >= 2
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN s.server_label IN (${server:sqlstring}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.phones_on_same_ip),0) AS value
FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows r JOIN latest l ON l.captured_at=r.captured_at
JOIN xips x ON x.last_ip=r.last_ip WHERE r.proxy_status_scope='${proxy_scope}'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT last_ip) AS value FROM (
  SELECT s.captured_at, s.last_ip
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
  WHERE s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}' AND $__timeFilter(s.captured_at)
    AND s.last_ip <> '__snapshot_empty__'
  GROUP BY s.captured_at, s.last_ip
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.server_label) >= 2
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN s.server_label IN (${server:sqlstring}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
) t

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.captured_at AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Shared IPs across servers"
FROM (
  SELECT s.captured_at, s.last_ip
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
  WHERE s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}' AND $__timeFilter(s.captured_at)
    AND s.last_ip <> '__snapshot_empty__'
  GROUP BY s.captured_at, s.last_ip
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.server_label) >= 2
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN s.server_label IN (${server:sqlstring}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
) t
GROUP BY t.captured_at
ORDER BY t.captured_at

panels.title: Shared IPs across servers — over time

panels.description: Each IP that was shared across servers during the period: which servers, how many times it was seen, the most phones on it, the phone names and device IDs, and when it was last seen.

targets.rawSql:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT s.captured_at, s.last_ip
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
  WHERE s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}' AND $__timeFilter(s.captured_at)
    AND s.last_ip <> '__snapshot_empty__'
  GROUP BY s.captured_at, s.last_ip
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.server_label) >= 2
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN s.server_label IN (${server:sqlstring}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
)
SELECT q.last_ip AS `Shared IP`,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT srv.server_label ORDER BY srv.server_label SEPARATOR ', ') AS `Servers sharing it`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT q.captured_at) AS `Times seen`,
  MAX(r.phones_on_same_ip) AS `Max phones on IP`,
  SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(r.sibling_phones ORDER BY q.captured_at DESC SEPARATOR '||'), '||', 1) AS `Phones`,
  SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(r.device_ids ORDER BY q.captured_at DESC SEPARATOR '||'), '||', 1) AS `Device IDs`,
  MAX(q.captured_at) AS `Last seen`
FROM q
JOIN duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers srv
  ON srv.captured_at=q.captured_at AND srv.proxy_status_scope='${proxy_scope}' AND srv.last_ip=q.last_ip
LEFT JOIN duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows r
  ON r.captured_at=q.captured_at AND r.proxy_status_scope='${proxy_scope}' AND r.last_ip=q.last_ip
GROUP BY q.last_ip
ORDER BY `Times seen` DESC, `Last seen` DESC

panels.title: Shared IPs over the period — who shared, phones & devices

panels.description: Each pair of servers that shared at least one IP during the period, and how many IPs they had in common. 'Unknown' = phones whose names don't follow the S##P## format.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CONCAT(LEAST(a.server_label,b.server_label),' ↔ ',GREATEST(a.server_label,b.server_label)) AS `Server pair`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.last_ip) AS `Shared IPs`
FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers a
JOIN duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers b
  ON a.captured_at=b.captured_at AND a.proxy_status_scope=b.proxy_status_scope
 AND a.last_ip=b.last_ip AND a.server_label < b.server_label
WHERE a.proxy_status_scope='${proxy_scope}' AND $__timeFilter(a.captured_at)
  AND a.last_ip <> '__snapshot_empty__'
  AND (a.server_label IN (${server:sqlstring}) OR b.server_label IN (${server:sqlstring}))
GROUP BY `Server pair`
ORDER BY `Shared IPs` DESC

panels.title: Which servers overlapped — and how much

panels.description: IPs that kept showing up as shared across the period. A high 'Times shared' means a persistent problem IP, not a one-off.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT last_ip AS `Shared IP`,
  COUNT(*) AS `Times shared`,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(captured_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') ORDER BY captured_at SEPARATOR ' | ') AS `Shared at`,
  MAX(captured_at) AS `Last seen`
FROM (
  SELECT s.captured_at, s.last_ip
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
  WHERE s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}' AND $__timeFilter(s.captured_at)
    AND s.last_ip <> '__snapshot_empty__'
  GROUP BY s.captured_at, s.last_ip
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.server_label) >= 2
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN s.server_label IN (${server:sqlstring}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
) t
GROUP BY last_ip
ORDER BY `Times shared` DESC, `Last seen` DESC
LIMIT 100
